collectionHint: Monitoring continues while this server is running.
fleetOverview: A clear view of your hive.
subtitle: Compare your miners. Find your balance.
registrationHint: Connect to the same network as your miner. BitHive reads its AxeOS name automatically; leave the optional display name empty to use it.
partialMetrics: Some readings are missing; efficiency uses paired readings.
demoSummary: {{count}} simulated miners · {{hash}} TH/s · {{power}} W. Excluded from real fleet totals.
tableHint: Select a miner for history and settings.
emptyTitle: Your hive starts with one miner.
emptyHint: Add a local Bitaxe, or explore a simulated fleet with no hardware.
staleHint: Unavailable readings never contribute to live totals.
uncertainHint: Unverified or unknown changes may require time or a restart in AxeOS. Check the miner before sending another command. Passwords cannot be read back.
staleDeviceHint: These are the last successful readings. Configuration is disabled until the miner is online.
historyLimit: Up to {{count}} most recent samples in this period. Collection starts when a miner is registered.
chartWaiting: Collecting history. At least two readings are needed.
footer: Local data. Official device APIs. Your hive.
configureHint: Leave a field empty to keep its current value. Use device presets or acknowledge the risks to enter custom frequency and voltage.
batchHint: Options shown come from this miner. Every selected miner is checked independently; incompatible settings are rejected for that miner.
unsupportedTuning: This firmware does not report usable frequency or voltage options. Those controls remain read-only.
payoutHint: Enter the payout address or account and worker exactly as your pool requires. Multi-pool firmware edits only the active primary slot.
writeVerification: Each miner is read again after the change.
saveProfileHint: Enter a name to save the current operating settings, including any pending edits. Saving a profile does not apply settings to the miner.

errors.invalidInput: Check the entered values and try again.
errors.localAddressRequired: Use a private local IPv4 address or a hostname resolving to one.
errors.deviceTimeout: The miner did not respond in time. Check its address and connection.
errors.deviceUnavailable: The miner is unreachable. Check its address, power, and network.
errors.deviceRejected: The firmware rejected the request. Check network access in AxeOS.
errors.invalidDeviceResponse: The device returned an invalid response. Check firmware compatibility.
errors.unsupported: This firmware does not support the requested setting.
errors.unsupportedProfile: The frequency or voltage is not in this device’s reported options.
errors.manualFanRequiresManualMode: Select manual cooling before setting a manual fan speed.
errors.notFound: This miner was not found. Refresh the fleet.
errors.forbidden: Request blocked. Open BitHive from its local address.
errors.fleetLimit: This version supports up to 500 registered miners.
errors.profileLimit: This miner already has 20 saved profiles.
errors.operationFailed: The operation failed. Check the server and network, then try again.
errors.tuningOwnsDevice: Tuning or recovery owns this miner. Stop the run and verify restoration before changing settings.
errors.tuningNotValidated: This device adapter does not support automatic tuning.
errors.tuningAlreadyActive: Another tuning run owns the tuning slot.
errors.idempotencyConflict: This request identifier was already used with different settings.
errors.tuningNotActive: This run does not allow that action.
errors.tuningCannotResume: This run cannot resume until restoration is verified and safety faults are resolved.
errors.unsafeRecovery: Recovery would increase voltage after a safety stop.
errors.physicalTuningAcknowledgementRequired: Acknowledge the risks before starting automatic tuning on this physical miner.
errors.missingActualFrequency: This firmware does not report a valid actualFrequency. You can acknowledge using configured frequency for this run.
errors.missingConfiguredFrequency: The configured frequency is missing or invalid. Tuning cannot continue.

nameFromAxeos: Use the name configured in AxeOS
displayNameHint: Changes the label in BitHive only. Works even when the miner is offline.
hostnameHint: Changes the name on the miner and its .local address. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens (up to 63 characters). BitHive keeps the connection by IP and verifies the change. Uncertain results must be checked in AxeOS before trying again.
hostnameUnavailable: This firmware does not report a configurable hostname. You can still change the BitHive display name.
chartKeyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to inspect readings, Home or End for the first or last reading, and Escape to hide the tooltip.
powerEquation: Miner power {{reported}} W + estimated supply loss {{loss}} W = estimated wall draw {{total}} W
powerEstimateSubtitle: Miners + supply loss = wall estimate · {{efficiency}}% efficiency
powerReportedSubtitle: Online miners only · excludes power supply losses
measurementHint: Enter the wattmeter total for the online miners. Supply efficiency is calculated from their current reported power and saved for future estimates.
invalidWallPower: Enter a positive wall reading at least as large as miner power. Miner power must be greater than zero.
efficiencyWithSupplyLoss: Includes power supply losses · J/TH at the wall
invalidEfficiency: Enter an efficiency greater than 0% and at most 100%.
partialPower: Some online miners have no power reading; totals and estimates are partial.
expandedDifficulty: Expanded from the shortened value reported by the firmware.

tuner.hostRequired: Tuning continues when this browser closes. Keep the BitHive server running and connected; sleeping or unreachable hosts cannot restore miners.
tuner.physicalGate: Automatic tuning changes frequency, voltage and fan settings and can cause instability, overheating or hardware damage. Confirm that manual changes work on this firmware and review every limit. BitHive will attempt to restore original settings on pause, stop or completion; restoration requires a running server and a reachable miner. This acknowledgement applies to this run, including recovery after a server restart.
tuner.preview: Actual grid: {{fmin}}–{{fmax}} MHz · {{vmin}}–{{vmax}} mV · {{count}} candidates. Maximum estimated active duration: {{minutes}} minutes, including confirmation fallbacks and recovery. Pauses and server downtime are unbounded.
tuner.fastClaim: Best among tested configurations. Fast mode may skip candidates; results do not establish a global optimum or long-term stability.
tuner.completeClaim: Best passing configurations on the tested grid. Results do not establish a global optimum or long-term stability.

reasons.externalChange: External settings change; review before resuming
reasons.frequencyMismatch: Actual frequency differs from requested setting
reasons.recoveryFailed: Restoration could not be verified; manual recovery required
reasons.missingActualFrequency: This firmware does not report a valid actualFrequency. You can acknowledge using configured frequency for this run.
reasons.missingConfiguredFrequency: The configured frequency is missing or invalid. Tuning cannot continue.

design.windowDescription: Current profile: {{frequency}} MHz, {{voltage}} mV. Search bounds: {{fmin}} to {{fmax}} MHz and {{vmin}} to {{vmax}} mV.
design.currentPoint: Current profile within the search bounds
design.outsideWindow: Current profile is outside the search bounds
design.winnerPending: Passing candidates need a longer confirmation before they appear here.
design.setupHint: Operating bounds, limits and observation time
design.rangeHint: Frequency increases within each voltage sweep. Bounds start with the AxeOS preset range.
design.resultScroll: Tuning results; scroll horizontally for all measurements

tuner.physicalAcknowledgement: I understand the risks and authorize automatic tuning on this miner
tuner.configuredFrequencyWarning: Configured frequency is the firmware setting, not independent confirmation of the applied ASIC clock. Using it cannot detect clock ramping or throttling through actualFrequency. Temperature, hashrate, error checks and setting readback remain required. This choice is saved for the whole run, including resume and recovery.
tuner.acknowledgeConfiguredFrequency: I acknowledge this limitation — use configured frequency for this run
tuner.configuredFrequencyActive: Frequency source: configured setting (acknowledged). Applied ASIC clock is not independently verified.

customValuesAcknowledgement: I understand the risks and want to enter custom frequency and voltage values
customValuesHint: Custom values can cause instability, overheating or hardware damage. Check the limits for your miner and power supply. This acknowledgement only unlocks manual inputs in BitHive; it does not enable AxeOS OC mode or automatic tuning.
